leads.name: BlueCore Energy
leads.firstSignal: Filed first Form D: $9.2M sold of $10.0M in equity from 14 investors
leads.announcement: A press release on the company's site announced emergence from stealth with an approximately $10 million round led by Slauson & Co.

leads.name: Robocurve
leads.firstSignal: Domain robocurve.org was registered on Jun 24
leads.announcement: Aris Zhu, then a co-founder, posted on LinkedIn that Zhu and Jay Chooi were in Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch building Robocurve.

leads.name: Salem Robotics
leads.firstSignal: Listed in YC Summer 2026 under Manufacturing and Robotics, now a team of 2
leads.announcement: Non Sibi Ventures published a Substack post explaining why it invested in Salem Robotics, with no amount given.

leads.name: Copperhead
leads.firstSignal: Organization created Aug 7 now hosts copperhead with 18 contributors and 331 stars
leads.announcement: Copperhead was first presented as an open-source AI agent for PCB design in an Antler Crackathon submission post on its blog.

leads.name: Hebbian Robotics
leads.firstSignal: Certificates issued in the last 120 days name 2 notable subdomains: api and docs
leads.announcement: Co-founder Kingston Kuan posted on X and LinkedIn that Hebbian Robotics had joined Y Combinator's S26 batch, with no amount stated.

leads.name: Rosota
leads.firstSignal: First indexed paper under the company name, with at least 4 of 12 authors listing it
leads.announcement: A KRW 1.5 billion seed round led by FuturePlay with Schmidt and ZDVC, reported by Asia Economy, the earliest press report found.

leads.name: Surtr Defense Systems
leads.firstSignal: Received FCC special temporary authority for radar testing at Pelion, South Carolina, 16 days after filing
leads.announcement: The founders unveiled the company and ParallaxOS in a Launch YC post on ycombinator.com.

leads.name: FPF Defense
leads.firstSignal: Filed its first 3 trademark applications in one day for unmanned aerial vehicles, all intent to use
leads.announcement: The Wall Street Journal named FPF-Defense as the company Chris Miller now runs, a passing mention in a news article quoting him.

leads.name: Swarm Defense Technologies
leads.firstSignal: Filed first Form D: $1.4M sold of an indefinite offering in equity from 10 investors
leads.announcement: A State of Michigan press release named Swarm Defense among the 2025 Mobility Prototyping Grant winners, for a target drone production line.

leads.name: AMPERA
leads.firstSignal: Filed intent-to-use trademark AMPERA for nuclear reactors
leads.announcement: Ampera left stealth via PR Newswire, describing 15 MWe and 30 MWe subcritical thorium microreactor configurations and an unnamed Fortune 500 backer.

leads.name: Veridis Defense
leads.firstSignal: Domain veridisdefense.com was registered on Sep 19
leads.announcement: The company, then called AdAstra Defense, was first presented publicly in a LinkedIn post by Hubert Krzysztofik linking to its deck.

leads.name: First American Nuclear (FANCO)
leads.firstSignal: Filed its first 3 trademark applications in one day for nuclear reactors, all in use
leads.announcement: In a PR Newswire release, the company introduced itself and its Eagle One reactor ahead of an investor summit in Oak Ridge.

leads.name: Orkora
leads.firstSignal: Filed intent-to-use trademark ORKORA for nuclear reactors, its first trademark filing
leads.announcement: NEMO announced Orkora as a new full member on its news page, describing a planned fleet of floating nuclear power stations.

leads.name: Deployable Energy
leads.firstSignal: NRC scheduled a meeting for Jun 17 on docket 99902155
leads.announcement: The Fiji Times reported Fiji's prime minister saying the government was working with Deployable Energy and others on shipboard micro modular reactors.

leads.name: Advanced Float
leads.firstSignal: New NRC pre-application docket 99902176 appeared with a Regulatory Engagement Plan
leads.announcement: Mirai Sozo Investments announced on its news page that its Fund II had invested in Advanced Float's 100 million yen pre-seed round.

leads.name: Chariot Defense
leads.firstSignal: 9 open roles, none posted in the last 30 days
leads.announcement: Chariot Defense was first named publicly in a Naval Postgraduate School news story on DVIDS about the JIFX field experiment.

leads.name: Poseidon Aerospace
leads.firstSignal: 19 of 22 open roles first published on Sep 5: a new or republished job board
leads.announcement: CEO David Zagaynov unveiled the company's Seagull sea glider in a video posted on X.

leads.name: Alva Energy
leads.firstSignal: NRC scheduled a pre-application meeting for Jul 23 on docket 99902154
leads.announcement: Alva's own blog announced its contribution to the DOE Advanced Nuclear Liftoff report, the earliest dated company announcement found.

leads.name: Valstad Shipworks
leads.firstSignal: Filed first Form D: $8.6M sold of $11.3M in equity from 15 investors
leads.announcement: The company's launch post under its earlier name Joliet, on its own site joliet.ai, described its plan for automated ship factories.

leads.name: Angel Aerial Systems
leads.firstSignal: FAA accepted a Remote ID declaration for aircraft model Trio Scout, its first on the FAA list
leads.announcement: Angel Aerial Systems publicly revealed its first product, the Trio drone, at XPONENTIAL 2024 in San Diego, reported by Commercial UAV News.

leads.name: Aerovec
leads.firstSignal: First federal award on record, $75K Air Force SBIR/STTR order: Rapid-deployment containerized wind turbine…
leads.announcement: The Business Journals (Buffalo Inno) ran a story headlined "Aerovec raises funds on the road to commercialization" (article text not opened).

leads.name: Parallel Robotics
leads.firstSignal: First federal award on record, $305K NSF SBIR Phase I: A Novel Architecture for blending Human Power and…
leads.announcement: University of Michigan's Michigan Engineering News said Shorya Awtar was on leave launching his new company, Parallel Robotics.

leads.name: FibrX
leads.firstSignal: First federal award on record, $105K Air Force SBIR/STTR order: Dual-use fiber optic sensor suite for in…
leads.announcement: An OODA Loop article listed fibrX among the 2022 finalists of the DHS Homeland Security Startup Studio.

leads.name: Aloft Sensing
leads.firstSignal: Received FCC special temporary authority for high-altitude platform testing, 18 days after filing
leads.announcement: The company's own blog announced an Air Force Phase I SBIR award, and no launch or funding-round announcement was found.
